patch_list: Disable analytics
Disables PulseSDK analytics.
MicroG support
Fixes Google sign-in and sync on patched builds: routes Google services through MicroG-RE and reports the original certificate to Firebase. Requires MicroG-RE with a Google account.
Unlock Premium
Unlocks premium features and removes ads.

sources.label: Some patches made with AI for Morphe-Patches
sources.author: Santodan
patch_list: Pillo - Hybrid Lock-Screen Notifications
Use fullscreen alarms while the phone is locked and banner notifications while it is unlocked. Select Pillo's Banner/Light notification mode.
Pillo - Import weight history from JSON
Adds a native Import weights JSON button above Skip in Weight > Add record. Imports SWT backup weights with their dates into the selected profile, with kg/lb selection and duplicate skipping.
Pillo - Local backup and restore
Adds local-file export and restore of Pillo's database, settings and app-managed files, without Google sign-in. Restore replaces current data, keeps a recovery backup and restarts Pillo.
Pillo - Premium and ad-free
Enables premium and ad-free state through Pillo's native subscription setters. For 0.6.27; select instead of an external Unlock Premium patch.
Pillo - Weight change summaries
Adds signed Total weight change, an All default filter, a selectable Last since date, and Last 30 days / Last 15 days / Change summaries using full profile history.
Pillo - Weight in Progress
Shows the native weight graph, weight-change summaries and dated record list below the existing Progress calendar. Includes Weight change summaries.
